summary: Markdown heading convention: # for page titles, ## for sections, one more # per subsection, and avoid going deeper than ####.
questions: How deep should Markdown headings go in Ansible docs?
Which Markdown heading level is the page title?

answer_card.title: Markdown heading notation
answer_card.answer_md:
- `#` page title
- `##` sections
- add `#` per subsection level

Don't go beyond `####`; deeper nesting suggests splitting into pages.
